steps.setupOverview: Start by looking at your current hand.
steps.drawOverview: Your goal is to finish with the highest-scoring seven-card hand. On your turn, you either draw 1 card from the deck or take 1 card from the discard pile.
steps.discardAfterDraw: Queen is not helping this hand right now. Select Queen and discard it.
steps.setupTakeCenter: If the center already has the card you need, you can take it directly.
steps.takeCenterCard: Bell Tower is in the center now, and it scores with the Candle in your hand. Select Bell Tower to take it.
steps.discardAfterCenter: Now select Rainstorm and discard it.
steps.setupScoreShowcase: This hand is close to the endgame. Now look at how it scores.
steps.scoreIntro: This hand finishes at 198 points. Candle scoring with Bell Tower and a Wizard is the main reason this total climbs so high.
steps.scoreCardDetails: Hover or tap a card to inspect how that single card scores.
steps.scoreTotalReview: The upper-right total shows the final score for this hand.
steps.endgameReview: When the center discard pile reaches 10 cards, each player compares the final score of their seven-card hand. The highest score wins.
steps.finish: Now start a real game of Fantasy Realms.
